name: Religious Hypocrites
overview: The Scriptures warn strongly against religious hypocrisy, emphasizing that outward displays of righteousness for human approval are worthless before God, who desires genuine obedience and heart transformation. Jesus rebukes the scribes and Pharisees for their hypocrisy in neglecting the core principles of judgment, mercy, and faith while meticulously observing minor rituals. True discipleship requires doing the will of the Father rather than merely professing faith, and believers are called to examine their own hearts before judging others, recognizing their own faults first. This teaching highlights the danger of self-righteousness and the necessity of sincere devotion to God.
